Hero backgrounds weigh 48–52 MB

The homepage selects a 51.7 MB animated hero on mobile and a 48.0 MB version on desktop, while hidden testimonial players also load early.

  • Use quality-preserving lightweight posters or efficient video versions for #section-58-14, preventing the old animated downloads.
  • Delay the three inactive testimonial players until needed; separately test the section-211-14 background discovery and retest the 59/56 mobile benchmarks.

Business markup and one FAQ entry need repair

  • Consolidate malformed Dentist blocks with the correct name, suite, current logo and clinic pin 26.0090104,-80.1840416; retain valid hours, phone and business fields.
  • Remove only the empty fifth veneers disclosure and empty Question/Answer markup, preserving the four real questions and answers.
